Value-Suppressing Uncertainty Palettes

Source: R/vsup_palette.R
vsup_palette.Rd

vsup_palette() handles colour generation for VSUP scales. It modifies the supplied base colours by progressively desaturating and lightening them as uncertainty increases.

Usage

vsup_palette(
  leaf_info,
  colours,
  layers = 4,
  branch = 2,
  max_light = 0.7,
  max_desat = 0.9,
  pow_light = 1,
  pow_desat = 1,
  space = "Lab"
)

Arguments

leaf_info

A data frame describing the VSUP bin structure, produced by vsup_quantize(). It stores the leaf identifiers, uncertainty layers, and value positions used to assign colours.

colours

A character vector of colours used as key points for interpolating the value colour scale at the lowest uncertainty level.

layers

An integer specifying the number of uncertainty levels in the VSUP hierarchy.

branch

An integer specifying the branching factor used to determine the number of value bins across uncertainty levels. The maximum number of value bins is branch^(layers - 1), with fewer value bins used at higher uncertainty levels.

max_light

A numeric value specifying the maximum amount of lightening applied across uncertainty levels.

max_desat

A numeric value specifying the maximum amount of desaturation applied across uncertainty levels.

pow_light, pow_desat

Numeric values controlling the rate of lightening and desaturation across uncertainty levels.

space

A character string specifying the colour space used for colour interpolation.
